chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 581 - Ji Ning Claims the Starseizing Estate's Hidden Army and Three Secret Treasures
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning formally becomes the master of the Starseizing Estate, receiving the loyalty of seven ancient Empyrean Gods and a sealed major world. He also learns of three legendary treasures left by Daoist Threelives.
og_title: A New Faction is Born! Ji Ning Claims the Starseizing Estate!
og_description: Ji Ning becomes the head of a legendary faction, commanding seven Empyrean Gods and a hidden army of millions. The hunt for three secret treasures begins!
twitter_title: Ji Ning's new faction is stacked! A hidden world, ancient Empyrean Gods, and three secret treasures await!
twitter_description: Ji Ning takes his place as the master of the Starseizing Estate, a new major player in the Realm War. The true inheritance of Daoist Threelives is about to be unlocked!

lore_anchors.definition: The legacy faction of the true god Daoist Threelives, a dormant power now awakened under Ji Ning's leadership, possessing a sealed major world and seven loyal Empyrean God commanders.
A primordial true god and creator of the legendary Starseizing Hand divine ability. He was a former warlord who built the Starseizing Estate and left a hidden inheritance for his successor.
The divine material created by the goddess Nuwa to mend the sky; Sun Wukong was born from a piece of this stone, explaining his innate, monstrous talent for cultivation.
A high-stage of immortal cultivation, characterized by the formation of a 'Pure Yang Golden Core'. It is a major power threshold, placing Ji Ning on par with the most ancient of experts.
A massive, planet-like realm, often larger than a standard world, used to house powerful sects and vast populations of cultivators.
The body-refining equivalent of a True Immortal, possessing immense physical power, devastating combat capabilities, and a divine body.
A form of mental and spiritual energy based on the cultivator's will and Dao-heart; Ji Ning has mastered the fourth level, granting him immense sensory and will-based power.
A colossal battle avatar formed by the coordinated formation of hundreds of Celestial Immortals and Loose Immortals, a terrifying weapon of war.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why are there no True Immortals or Empyrean Gods in the Starseizing Major World?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because the world has been sealed for countless ages, preventing its cultivators from the tempering and tribulations needed to break through to the next major realm.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Silvermoon consider joining the Starseizing Estate?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Silvermoon is a roaming cultivator who sees the coming calamity as a reason to take sides. He respects Ji Ning's potential and finds the Starseizing Estate's offer attractive.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What are the three treasures left by Daoist Threelives?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The chapter ends with the reveal that three powerful treasures, traded for by Threelives himself, are locked away for the new master of the Starseizing Estate, their nature and power currently unknown.
